asr.full_text: Introducing the MTI Company. Mirror Trading International, Pty Ltd, is a registered company in the Republic of South Africa. The registered office is situated at 341 Bears Nord Deer Drive in Northcliffe, Randburgh, Johannesburg, South Africa. The MTI Support Office is situated in Stellenbosch in the Western Cape of South Africa. Johan Steinberg is the CEO and founder from Polokwani, which is also in South Africa. Johann Steinberg is the CEO and founder from Poloqvani, which is also in South Africa. The Attorneys and legal advisors for MTI are Ulrich Roux and associates who have their offices in Parkhurst Johannesburg. The objective of MTI is to grow your Bitcoin. Your balance in trade is always in rise when the price of its price rises. of Mirror Trading International comes solely from the trading activities. Your full investment goes into your trading account. MTI provides you with a passive income opportunity, earn passively from daily trading which takes place from Monday to Friday. Remember the trade results are not guaranteed but no trading knowledge is required. To get started you will need A Bitcoin wallet To register with MTI and $100 in Bitcoin, which is the suggested min and you will need to fund your account within 7 days Accounts not funded will be deleted from the system, after the 7 days In MTI there are no membership fees no subscriptions no packages no costs, no packages, no costs, and no deductions. Remember your full Bitcoin payment goes to your trading account . There are no contracts or lockdowns. You can withdraw in full or partial amounts. And you can withdraw whenever you like. There are no withdrawal fees or penalties. If you make a withdrawal request, the Bitcoin will be sent to your wallet within 48 hours. Please remember to confirm your withdrawal request on your email. Profits from successful daily trades are divided and allocated as follows. 40% goes to you the member, 20% to the binary bonus pool, 5% to the P1 and P2 leadership bonus pool, 25% to the trading system, and 10% goes to MTI for administration and to pay the referral bonuses. All income is subject to positive daily trading results. The system is fully automated and you can sit back and relax and receive your daily statements in your back office detailing income from the trades for the day. Your daily trade income is automatically compounded. Members are not permitted their own broker accounts as per terms of the software license agreement. Your account remains active provided you maintain a minimum balance in trade. the suggested amount is $100 in Bitcoin. Providing you with a passive, sustainable income from your Bitcoin in trade is at the very heart of MTI. That summarizes the passive part of the opportunity, and as a member, you will earn from the daily trading activities and grow your Bitcoin. MTI has an optional Affiliate Program, should you wish to refer your friends or new members. MTI offers four types of Affiliate Rewards. 10% for Direct Referral Bonuses, 20% Weekly Profsharing bonus, and 2.5% to each of the P1 and P2 Leadership Bonuses . All bonuses come from daily trading income and are therefore financially sustainable. You will earn a ten-percent referral bonus for every member who joins you and also for any amounts they add over and above the original investment. You will need at least $50 of Bitcoin in your investment account to qualify to earn the ten percent direct referral bonuses. 20% of Daily Income results are allocated to the weekly binary profit-sharing pool. The binary structure works as follows. are allocated to the weekly binary profit-sharing pool. The binary structure works as follows. You can recruit new members into your left or right leg. To qualify for binary bonuses, you also need a minimum amount of $200 in the trading pool and you will need to have personally recruited one new member in to your left and one into your right leg. These 2 people need at least $100 of bitcoin in their trading account for you to qualify. The third person you personally introduce will become Spillover to one of the people you introduce as you can only place people into your left or right side. Spillover will also occur if your sponsor or team members above you introduce people into a leg. 20% of the income from the week's trading will be shared according to the Bitcoin value of your weaker leg. Remember, it's not about the number of members but the volume of Bitcoin invested in your weaker leg. When you're binary qualified, your $200 to $999 in your account, we allow you to earn up to 10 levels in the binary. As your team grows, you can increase your amount in trade, so that you can qualify to earn on more levels. With 1,000 to 4,999 dollars in your trading account, you'll receive bonuses up to twenty levels deep. $5,000 to $9,999 accounts will receive bonuses up to 30 levels deep. With $10,000 or more you'll receive bonuses on infinite levels of the binary structure in your weakest leg. Binary bonuses are paid every week on the bitcoin value in your weaker leg, creating your weekly residual income. There is a maximum binary cap of $15,000 worth of Bitcoin per day and $75,000 dollars worth of Bitcoin per week. All referral and binary bonuses are subject to a 7-day waiting period. Explaining the leadership bonuses. Part 1 is a sharing bonus, where you and the other Qualified members earn for 8 weeks. Part II is an ongoing bonus which is earned for helping your Team members become Binary Qualified, and is an ongoing bonus. To qualify to earn the P1 leadership bonuses, you'll need two direct referrals with $ 200 worth of Bitcoin in their trading-accounts, and additionally, you'll need at least 200 worth of Bitcoin in their trading accounts and additionally you will need at least 200 of Bitcoin in your own trading account. to qualify to earn the P2 bonuses your direct referrals will need to have done the same. It links binary and residual-income benefits to account balances, increased trading amounts, and personally recruiting participants, while directly inviting viewers to join and contact the referrer. Although it states that results are not guaranteed and depend on positive trading results, the material does not establish actual deposits, payouts, withdrawals, or realized losses.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The presentation prominently ties income to recruiting members into left and right legs, team growth, binary qualification, and earnings across multiple levels. It also promotes Bitcoin participation in daily trading for passive income, supporting S03 as a secondary mechanism.
